answer: Weight each identity by the minimum graph cut separating its attesters from the honest core. Every identity is a vertex; real endorsements trace back to an oasis of long-lived unaffiliated nodes a farm cannot fabricate. N clones share one thin boundary, so the flow across that low-permeability shale seam caps the whole cluster at its genuine outside edges regardless of headcount, giving each split vertex 1/N influence. Two farms that countersign merely widen their mutual cut while their reach to the oasis stays fixed. Forged edges are slashed when the cut is re-audited at settlement.
